prompt.description: What to make, for text to 3D. Used when no image is given.
examples: a stylized ceramic teapot shaped like a snail
prompt.title: Prompt

negative_prompt.description: What to keep out, for text to 3D.
negative_prompt.title: Negative Prompt

image.description: The object, or its front view when side views are given. JPEG or PNG.
image.title: Image

left_image.description: Left view of the object, for multiview. Needs image.
left_image.title: Left Image

back_image.description: Back view of the object, for multiview. Needs image.
back_image.title: Back Image

right_image.description: Right view of the object, for multiview. Needs image.
right_image.title: Right Image

texture.description: Texture the model. Off returns the bare mesh and costs less.
texture.title: Texture

pbr.description: Add PBR material maps. Turns texture on.
pbr.title: Pbr

texture_quality.description: fast and standard cost the same; detailed (HD) and extreme (8K) cost more.
texture_quality.title: Texture Quality

geometry_quality.description: detailed is Ultra geometry and costs 20 credits more.
geometry_quality.title: Geometry Quality

face_limit.description: Maximum face count. Empty: chosen by Tripo. Up to 1.5M, 2M with detailed geometry, 150K with quad, 20K with smart_low_poly.
face_limit.title: Face Limit

quad.description: Quad mesh, delivered as FBX. Costs 5 credits more.
quad.title: Quad

smart_low_poly.description: Hand-crafted style low-poly topology. Costs 10 credits more.
smart_low_poly.title: Smart Low Poly

generate_parts.description: Split the model into editable parts. Needs texture and pbr off; costs 20 credits more.
generate_parts.title: Generate Parts

auto_size.description: Scale the model to real-world size in meters.
auto_size.title: Auto Size

enable_image_autofix.description: Let Tripo clean up a single input image first.
enable_image_autofix.title: Enable Image Autofix

texture_alignment.description: Align the texture to the input image, or to the geometry.
texture_alignment.title: Texture Alignment

orientation.description: align_image turns the model to match the image.
orientation.title: Orientation

image_seed.description: Seed for the image Tripo draws from the prompt, for text to 3D.
image_seed.title: Image Seed
